GAP-APPLICATION-DECORATION.productionImpact: Human descriptions, UI labels, pricing, currency, threshold policy, and other application decoration are deliberately outside conserved physical models.
GAP-APPLICATION-DECORATION.requiredMitigation: Keep decoration separate from physical selection/quantity and prove it cannot mutate authoritative state.

GAP-ARBITRARY-AUDIT-METADATA.productionImpact: Arbitrary JSON-safe audit/application metadata is not represented in resource-conservation models.
GAP-ARBITRARY-AUDIT-METADATA.requiredMitigation: Metamorphic tests must prove audit-only changes preserve abstract physical state; changed retry intent under one operation identity remains fail-closed.

GAP-BROAD-RESERVATION-DENSE-GRAPH.productionImpact: Exact-position reservations use the sparse linear fast path, but truly broad competing claims still require a bounded max-flow graph over eligible claims and positions. The implementation fails closed at configured claim, position, edge, and indivisible-search ceilings rather than promising unbounded latency.
GAP-BROAD-RESERVATION-DENSE-GRAPH.requiredMitigation: Keep current hard ceilings and diagnostics, monitor broad-claim cardinality in production, partition unusually broad scopes, and add a specialized solver only if measured clinic workloads approach the bounds.

GAP-COUNT-CORRECTION-HISTORY-REPLAY.productionImpact: Observation-time count reconciliation and retained-root correction must reconstruct occurrence-sensitive physical history. The implementation now traverses the durable sequence index and uses a private linear replay builder, but latency and memory still grow with retained event history rather than remaining constant-time.
GAP-COUNT-CORRECTION-HISTORY-REPLAY.requiredMitigation: Keep the 500-to-2,000-event near-linear replay regression, measure event-history length on real clinics, and introduce trusted projection checkpoints or segmented history before long-lived streams approach operational replay limits.

GAP-DB-IMPLEMENTATION-UNBOUNDED.productionImpact: This standalone core executes the memory reference adapter only. Mongo/SQLite conformance and failpoint schedules are downstream integration evidence and still cannot prove every database/driver/runtime behavior.
GAP-DB-IMPLEMENTATION-UNBOUNDED.requiredMitigation: Each production adapter must pin supported versions, run its own CAS/uniqueness/private-class/failpoint/conformance suite in downstream CI, and fail closed on unsupported guarantees.

GAP-DISTRIBUTED-RIGHTS-NOT-IMPLEMENTED.productionImpact: The DistributedRights model does not imply offline or partition-tolerant multiwriter decrement/reservation safety in current adapters.
GAP-DISTRIBUTED-RIGHTS-NOT-IMPLEMENTED.requiredMitigation: Use one coordinating authoritative stream. Do not advertise offline/multiwriter stock until escrow/right-transfer code and adapter refinement tests exist.

GAP-EXTERNAL-CLOCK.productionImpact: Canonical time validation is tested, but correctness assumes the injected clock supplies canonical UTC instants and trusted monotonic record sequencing where required.
GAP-EXTERNAL-CLOCK.requiredMitigation: Validate every persisted time, distinguish occurrence from record time, and use database recordSequence/CAS rather than wall-clock expiry for safety.

GAP-EXTERNAL-MIGRATION-CALLBACKS.productionImpact: InventoryOnce cannot formally prove arbitrary application-owned query, bundle, or declaration callbacks.
GAP-EXTERNAL-MIGRATION-CALLBACKS.requiredMitigation: Bound query paging, require deterministic plugin output, retain source provenance, run the produced declaration through normal validation, and separately test each production plugin.

GAP-EXTERNAL-POLICY-CALLBACKS.productionImpact: Public low-level allocation/catalog callbacks can encode arbitrary application policy that is not represented by the finite TLA state machines.
GAP-EXTERNAL-POLICY-CALLBACKS.requiredMitigation: Production application code should prefer declarative grouped APIs; callback output must pass exact validators and dedicated application tests, and callbacks must be deterministic for retry.

GAP-FUNGIBILITY-EXACT-SEARCH-BOUND.productionImpact: Fungibility allocation uses exact bounded integer search with reservation-feasibility acceptance. Hypothetical states now use sparse overlays and do not clone unrelated projection rows, but adversarial candidate/increment combinations may still explore up to the configured 100,000 search-state ceiling and then fail closed.
GAP-FUNGIBILITY-EXACT-SEARCH-BOUND.requiredMitigation: Keep the hard search-state ceiling and sparse-overlay regression, monitor real pool candidate cardinality/package increments, partition unusually broad pools/scopes, and add a specialized optimizer only if measured clinic workloads approach the bound.

GAP-HASH-COLLISION-ASSUMPTION.productionImpact: Content roots and intent digests assume collision resistance of the selected hash and canonical encoding.
GAP-HASH-COLLISION-ASSUMPTION.requiredMitigation: Keep canonical encoding tests, immutable blob verification, and fail closed on digest/root mismatch.

GAP-HISTORICAL-RESERVATION-RECONSTRUCTIO.productionImpact: Historical as-of reservation reads reconstruct lifecycle state from retained reservation operations. Current/live reads and exact feasibility are indexed, but very long historical operation books can make retrospective reports scale with retained claim history.
GAP-HISTORICAL-RESERVATION-RECONSTRUCTIO.requiredMitigation: Measure historical-report workloads on real clinics, retain paging/retention observability, and introduce reservation checkpoints or lifecycle snapshots before unbounded history makes retrospective reads operationally expensive.

GAP-JAVASCRIPT-RUNTIME.productionImpact: Executable refinement evidence runs the real TypeScript/JavaScript implementation but is not a machine-checked semantic proof of the JavaScript runtime.
GAP-JAVASCRIPT-RUNTIME.requiredMitigation: Use strict TypeScript, exact arithmetic, exhaustive finite traces, mutation/retry tests, and supported Node versions.

GAP-LEGACY-SOURCE-INTERPRETATION.productionImpact: The generic migration machinery proves deterministic compilation/publication, not that one clinic's ambiguous legacy rows were interpreted correctly.
GAP-LEGACY-SOURCE-INTERPRETATION.requiredMitigation: Replay each real clinic snapshot, review every blocker/assumption, compare roots and operational reports, and obtain explicit cutover approval.

GAP-PRODUCTION-STORAGE-SCALE-GC.productionImpact: The current adapter stores complete content-addressed world snapshots and lacks accepted production GC/segmentation evidence at broad scale.
GAP-PRODUCTION-STORAGE-SCALE-GC.requiredMitigation: Measure write amplification/retention on real clinic workloads and approve safe GC, segmentation, or checkpointing before broad production scale.

GAP-TEST-FAILPOINT-HOOK.productionImpact: Failure-injection callbacks are test controls, not production inventory semantics.
GAP-TEST-FAILPOINT-HOOK.requiredMitigation: Classify them unsupported/unmodelled and use them only to exercise modeled crash boundaries.

GAP-TLC-BOUNDED-DOMAINS.productionImpact: Every TLC result is finite-domain model checking, not a theorem over arbitrary identities, quantities, traces, TypeScript, or databases.
GAP-TLC-BOUNDED-DOMAINS.requiredMitigation: Keep exact model constants/counts in reports and pair each claimed model with executable refinement/property tests.

GAP-TRACEABILITY-ADVERSARIAL-GRAPH-SEARC.productionImpact: Whole-history graph replay now uses one private sequential builder and is near-linear for broad independent containment/genealogy graphs, but each newly added structural edge must still prove no ancestor/reachability path exists. Adversarial very deep containment chains or dense genealogy DAGs can therefore exceed linear time.
GAP-TRACEABILITY-ADVERSARIAL-GRAPH-SEARC.requiredMitigation: Keep the 250-to-1,000-edge replay regressions, measure real clinic graph depth/density, and introduce bounded topological/ancestor indexing or explicit safety ceilings before supporting very large industrial traceability graphs.

GAP-V1-CONTENT-ROOT-OBJECT-ORDER.productionImpact: The v1 durable content-root encoding sorts record identities but preserves the normalized typed row property order. Silently switching to recursive object-key sorting would change already-published roots.
GAP-V1-CONTENT-ROOT-OBJECT-ORDER.requiredMitigation: Production adapters must round-trip normalized v1 row shapes without reordering object fields. Any key-order-independent root algorithm must be introduced as an explicit versioned digest/root format with compatibility or migration evidence rather than silently changing v1 roots.
